# Evaluation Packs Reference

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/build_reference.py` from `sensoryforge describe --json`. Do not edit: change the code,
then run the command again. -->

The metric packs (`--packs`), check packs (`--check-packs`) and declared adapters (`--adapter`) that `sensoryforge evaluate run` can use. [Evaluating a World](../user_guide/evaluate_pipeline.md) explains the options, and [Evaluation Report Contract](report_contract.md) states what a report holds.

This page is generated from the evaluation registries by `python scripts/build_reference.py`.

## Metric packs { #metric-pack }

### `core` { #metric-pack-core }

Modality-neutral frame and response statistics.

Class: `sensoryforge.evaluate.audit.core_pack.CorePack`

### `tactile` { #metric-pack-tactile }

Episode phases and moving speed, read from the frames.

Class: `sensoryforge.evaluate.tactile.metrics.TactilePack`

## Check packs { #check-pack }

### `core` { #check-pack-core }

The checks every data set gets (`--packs core`).

Class: `sensoryforge.evaluate.checks.core_pack.CoreChecks`

### `tactile` { #check-pack-tactile }

The tactile pack.

Class: `sensoryforge.evaluate.tactile.checks.TactileChecks`

## Declared adapters { #declared-adapter }

### `tactile` { #declared-adapter-tactile }

Declares what a tactile world implies for each entry's metrics.

Class: `sensoryforge.evaluate.tactile.declared.TactileAdapter`
